levels.name: No tidiness target
levels.description: Tidiness Manager cannot resolve a scenario or readable source tree for maintainability scanning.
entry_criteria: Scenario name or path is provided
exit_criteria: The target scenario resolves to readable source files

levels.name: Maintainability scan available
levels.description: The provider can run the maintainability scan and return normalized findings for Test Genie and agents.
exit_criteria: Tidiness scan completes with structured findings and summary counts

levels.name: File size and local debt controlled
levels.description: Files stay within reviewable size boundaries and tracked debt markers do not accumulate beyond maintainable thresholds.
exit_criteria: No long-file or dense technical-debt findings block local maintainability

levels.name: Complexity and coupling controlled
levels.description: Highly branched functions and broad import surfaces are kept visible and below local maintainability thresholds.
entry_criteria: File size and local debt are controlled
exit_criteria: No high-complexity or high-coupling findings block local maintainability

levels.name: Duplication controlled
levels.description: Duplicated implementation blocks are low enough that fixes and behavior changes do not drift across copies.
exit_criteria: No duplicated-code findings block local maintainability

levels.name: Fleet-ready tidiness posture
levels.description: The scenario is clean enough for Test Genie delegation, cleanup campaign planning, and fleet-wide maintainability comparison.
exit_criteria: No Tidiness Manager findings block fleet validation
